reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Creation and purpose of council on library development
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 text and 2004/2018 history note. Directs the secretary of state to create the Secretary's Council on Library Development to advise the secretary and state library on library matters, recommend policies and programs, and communicate the value of libraries.

headings.title: Three-year rotating terms for council members
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 text and 2004/2018 history note. Sets three-year council member terms served on a rotating basis established by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Member appointments, represented groups, and ex-officio members
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 3 text and 2004/2018 history note. Provides for secretary of state appointments representing the public, libraries, Missouri library trustees, and state library users, alongside house members, senate members, and the state librarian serving ex officio.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 181.022 (subsections 1-3) and 2004/2018 history note; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked Secretary of State appointment scope, three-year rotating terms, and ex-officio legislative/state librarian roles. Retained all three drafted titles as accurate and distinct.

headings.title: Appropriating, administering, and distributing state library aid
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 text and 1945-2011 history notes. Reflects permissive general assembly appropriations for state aid to public libraries, administered by the state librarian and distributed under Missouri state library rules approved by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Per capita allocation, local support requirements, and levy exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 text and 1945-2011 history notes. Covers apportionment of at least fifty percent of aid on an equal per capita latest-federal-census basis, December 31, 1946 or establishment-date maintenance-of-effort floor, minimum tax-levy (sections 182.010-182.460 or 137.030) and non-tax city appropriation thresholds, and exceptions for section 137.073 levy reductions or section 182.802 sales-tax-offset voluntary levy reductions.

headings.title: Certifying local library funding and state payment amounts
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 3 text and 1945-2011 history notes. Requires annual local certification by the librarian and library or city treasurer to the state librarian of baseline and current tax income, rate, or appropriation, followed by state librarian certification of payment amounts to the commissioner of administration.

headings.title: Remaining grant purposes, establishment grants, and separate appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 4 including lead-in, subdivisions (1)-(7), continuation sentences in (7), and history notes. Covers discretionary grants from the remaining balance for seven listed purposes (retaining archived 'city, county city/county' wording in (1)), newly established library certifications and warrants, and separation of state-aid appropriations from state library appropriations.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 181.060 (subsections 1-4, subdivisions (1)-(7), continuation sentences in (7)) and 1945-2011 history notes; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked permissive appropriation language, per capita census allocation, December 31, 1946/establishment baselines, sections 182.010-182.460/137.030/137.073/182.802 cross-references, literal archived 'city, county city/county' wording in (4)(1), establishment grant certifications/warrants, and separate appropriations clause. Retained all four drafted titles.

headings.title: State appropriations for designated regional and subregional libraries
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 text, 1963-1991 history notes, and July 1, 1993 effective date. Reflects permissive general assembly appropriations to libraries designated by the Library of Congress National Library Service for the Blind and Physically Handicapped with state librarian concurrence to serve citizens eligible under Public Law 89-522 (1966).

headings.title: State librarian administration, budget requests, and subregional monitoring
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 text, 1963-1991 history notes, and July 1, 1993 effective date. Assigns the state librarian to administer blind and physically handicapped library services, request an annual operating budget for qualifying regional or subregional libraries under Public Law 89-522 (1966), and monitor designated Missouri subregional libraries.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 181.065 (subsections 1-2), 1963-1991 history notes, and July 1, 1993 effective-date note; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked permissive appropriation language, Library of Congress NLS designation with state librarian concurrence, Public Law 89-522 (1966) reference, budget request duty, and subregional monitoring. Retained both drafted titles.

headings.title: Definitions for sections 181.100 and 181.110
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 including lead-in and subdivisions (1)-(5) plus 1976-2018 history notes. Defines 'agency', 'electronic repository', 'format', 'publications', and 'state publications access program' for sections 181.100 and 181.110 unless context requires otherwise.

headings.title: Definition of report and request-only distribution limit
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 text and 1976-2018 history notes. Defines 'report' for sections 181.100 and 181.110 as periodic printed agency operational statements or formal written investigation accounts, and restricts distribution to other officials, agencies, or the public to upon-request only.

headings.title: Paper report copies for state libraries and officials
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 3 text and 1976-2018 history notes. Requires agencies distributing paper-printed periodic reports to furnish specified free copies (with cost and request-address statements) to the state library and fixed copy counts to the legislative library, house chief clerk, senate secretary, supreme court library, and governor.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 181.100 (subsections 1-3 and subdivisions (1)-(5)) and 1976-2018 history notes; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked sections 181.100 and 181.110 definitional scope, separate report definition and request-only distribution restriction, and free paper copy counts for state libraries and officials. Retained all three drafted titles.

headings.title: State agency submission, paper copy, and contact duties
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 including lead-in and subdivisions (1)-(3) plus 1976-2018 history notes. Requires each agency to submit publications electronically consistent with state enterprise architecture, supply secretary-of-state-determined paper copies for participating libraries, and annually designate a program contact.

headings.title: Secretary of state repository, format rules, and rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 including lead-in and subdivisions (1)-(3) plus history notes. Assigns the secretary of state to provide a multi-access secure electronic repository through the state library, establish acceptable electronic submission formats by rule, and optionally promulgate implementing rules for sections 181.100 and 181.110. Reviewer revised title from 'duties' to avoid overstating subdivision (3)'s permissive ('May') rulemaking authority.

headings.title: State library repository administration, classification, and publication lists
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 3 including lead-in and subdivisions (1)-(3) plus history notes. Requires the state library, consistent with e-government, to administer the electronic repository and distribute non-electronic formats to participating libraries, organize and classify publications regardless of format, and regularly publish a list of agency publications.

headings.title: Consistency with section 161.935
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 4 text and history notes. Requires all responsibilities and powers under section 181.110 to be carried out consistent with section 161.935.

headings.title: Chapter 536 rulemaking compliance and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 5 text and history notes. Conditions effectiveness of chapter 181 rules on compliance with chapter 536 and section 536.028 if applicable, and declares section 181.110 and chapter 536 nonseverable with post-August 28, 2004 rules void if legislative rule-review powers are held unconstitutional.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 181.110 (subsections 1-5 and all subdivisions) and 1976-2018 history notes; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked agency, secretary of state, and state library distinctions, section 161.935 consistency requirement, chapter 536/section 536.028 compliance, and post-August 28, 2004 nonseverability voidness clause. Revised subsection 2 title from 'duties' to 'Secretary of state repository, format rules, and rulemaking' so permissive ('May') rulemaking in (2)(3) is not overstated as mandatory; retained subsections 1 and 3-5.

headings.title: Wolfner Library Trust Fund creation and funding sources
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 1 text and 1997 history note. Establishes the Wolfner Library Trust Fund in the state treasury consisting of federal grants, contracts, gifts, bequests, or other funds contributed to Wolfner Library under section 181.021(6).

headings.title: Investment of fund moneys and crediting interest
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 2 text and 1997 history note. Directs the state treasurer to invest Wolfner Library Trust Fund moneys in the manner of surplus state funds under section 30.260 and credit all resulting interest to the fund.

headings.title: Exemption from biennial transfer to general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 3 text and 1997 history note. Operates notwithstanding section 33.080 so unexpended balances including accrued interest do not revert to the general revenue fund at the end of the biennium.

headings.title: Appropriated use for section 181.021(9) purposes
headings.reviewNote: Read complete subsection 4 text and 1997 history note. Restricts expenditure of the Wolfner Library Trust Fund, subject to appropriation, to purposes established under section 181.021(9).

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived section 181.150 (subsections 1-4) and 1997 history note; verified sourceUrl and all SHA-256 fingerprints. Checked exact cross-references to sections 181.021(6), 30.260, 33.080, and 181.021(9) and the subject-to-appropriation restriction. Retained all four drafted titles.
